name: Steal a Celebrity🌟
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal a Celebrity🌟
Get ready to dive into the world of fame and fortune!

👍 Like the game and join the group for exclusive rewards!

How to Play:
🎥 Buy a Famous and start building your fame!
🥷 Steal Famous from other players and rise to the top!
💸 Generate money to unlock new characters and upgrades!
🔥 Rebirth to increase your power and start again with more strength!
✋ Buy slaps and troll gear to mess with your friends and other players!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players play anytime, anywhere!
